create_code_formula_predictor: create a CodeFormulaPredictor instance with model artifacts path and device configuration
run_predict_code_images: run the predictor on a list of code snippet images with code labels to get text output
run_predict_formula_images: run the predictor on a list of formula images with formula labels to get LaTeX output
get_predictor_info: get the predictor info dict containing device and num_threads configuration
build_prompt_code: build a prompt string for the model using the code label with image tokens and query
